Five comments

The Fox In The Thatch

Tune by John Dwyer.
From The Dursey Sound - John Dwyer (fiddle) with Edel Fox (concertina), Neil Byrne (fiddle), Lia Byrne (fiddle).

↳ Posted by geoffwright on March 9th, 2016.

The Fox In The Thatch, X:2

From Mick, Louise & Michelle Mulcahy on The Reel Note.

↳ Posted by nervouswoman on October 29th, 2018.

Re: The Fox In The Thatch

The title refers to the session Edel Fox ran at a pub called The Thatch.

↳ Posted by GaryAMartin on October 31st, 2021.

The Fox In The Thatch, X:4

Got this setting from Mike Conway who got it from Tony O’Connell and Brid Harper recording. It is essentially a variation to the previous versions.

↳ Posted by Shelley on April 23rd, 2023.

The Fox In The Thatch, X:5

A transcription of Theresa O‘Grady’s variations on her album Banjo’ista.

↳ Posted by benhockenberry on August 8th, 2024.

The original link is thesession.org/tunes/15278
